text: Say what the product does, why this reader would use it, and the real next step. Match the brand's observed voice and the density of the current composition.

Before you write a prominent fact or outcome, find its supporting excerpt in your plan. Keep its terms, subject, units, eligibility and time window. If a detail is missing, look it up or narrow the claim; never fill it from memory.
Keep each metric with the customer it belongs to. A seller capability or another customer's result is not a forecast for this reader.

If requested proof has no support, write the useful narrower draft and name the gap in your review report. … Internal caveats and missing-source notes go in the review report, never in visitor-facing copy.
Never promise form delivery, consent handling or a response time without evidence that it is implemented.
